items.text: On the general pediatric ward, will a direct-cessation weaning protocol for infants aged 8 weeks or older with bronchiolitis, tested in PDSA cycles from November 2026 to March 2027, reduce the weekly median time on high flow from about 52 to 32 hours or less while re-escalation within 24 hours stays at or below 12 percent?
items.population: Infants aged 8 weeks or older with bronchiolitis on high-flow nasal cannula on the ward
items.intervention: Direct-cessation protocol with a trial off after two stable hours in FiO2 40 percent or less
items.comparator: Weekly baseline points from the 2025 to 2026 season
items.outcome: Weekly median hours on high flow; balancing: re-escalation, PICU transfer, 7-day readmission

finer: Feasible within staffing and the season; interesting to hospitalists, PICU and families; novel locally; ethical as QI with an age limit and stopping rules; relevant to every winter admission.
summary: One SMART QI aim with explicit safety balancing measures.
